name: Marimekko / Market Map
name_zh: 马赛克图 / 市场地图
summary: Variable-width 100% stacked columns: column width = segment size, stacks = player shares — the classic market map.
summary_zh: 可变宽度的百分比堆叠柱（市场地图）：柱宽代表细分市场规模，柱内堆叠代表各参与者份额。
description_zh: 咨询与投行最常用的市场结构图：横向每一列是一个细分市场，列宽与该市场规模成正比；列内自下而上堆叠各参与者在该市场的份额（合计 100%），因此每个格子的面积就是该参与者在整个市场中的规模。数据为长表：x（细分市场）、series（参与者）、value（收入），名为 Others / Other 的行合并为灰色“其他”并置于顶部，超出 maxSeries 的小参与者也归入其中。列顶标注市场名称、规模及占总市场的比例，格子内在空间允许时标注参与者与份额；目标公司用强调色高亮。适合回答“哪些市场大、谁在每个市场领先、客户的位置在哪里”。
best_for: Addressable market by segment and competitor
Revenue by region × segment (mix and concentration at once)
avoid_when: More than ~8 segments or ~8 players per column (labels no longer fit)
Segments of wildly different size (thin columns become unreadable)

series.desc: Stack / player field (height = share within the column)

value.desc: Size of each segment × player cell (rows are summed)

sort.desc: Column order by segment size: desc | asc | null (data order)

maxSeries.desc: Players beyond this (by overall size) are grouped into othersLabel

othersLabel.desc: Name of the grey residual bucket (rows named Others / Other … are merged into it)

highlight.desc: Player(s) drawn in the accent colour, e.g. the client

labels.desc: auto (player + share where it fits — wrapped, or on one line in flat bands; never truncated, no anonymous bare shares) | share | none

showTotals.desc: Segment name, total and share of market above each column

selectBy.desc: Click to cross-filter by the column ('x') or by the player ('series')

format.desc: Segment total format; defaults to the value field format

shareFormat.desc: Format of the shares in cells and headers

legend.desc: Player legend (top-left; hover to focus a player)

axes.desc: 0–100% axes: left = share of segment, bottom = cumulative share of market

interactions: Columns grow in, staggered left to right
Hover a cell or legend item to focus that player across all segments
Tooltip: value, share of segment, share of total market, segment total
Click a cell or column header to cross-filter (by segment or by player)
